finding: While both early and late-onset preeclampsia shared similar risk factors and no difference in fetal and neonatal outcomes after adjusting for gestational age, only older maternal age in primiparae was specific to early-onset preeclampsia.
mod_finding: This study found no difference in fetal and neonatal outcomes between women with early-onset preeclampsia and those with late-onset preeclampsia after adjusting for gestational age at delivery.
